about: Listening notes for StarCraft II's music files, keyed by file base name (no folder, no extension; match without regard to case). Gemini (gemini-flash-latest) listened to each file with no file name, game or context and wrote the words: kind, description, mood, tension, valence, energy, instrumentation, sections with start times, what it suits and what to avoid. The measurements (duration_s, lufs, lra, onset_rate, tempo_estimate_bpm, tempo_strength, fades, peak_at, energy_measured) are ours, taken from the audio. A model's hearing is a good first draft, not a source: corrections are welcome by pull request. CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA). Generated by scripts/build-music-notes.mjs from the research catalogue; nothing here is extracted from the game.

Amb_GroanDeepCave_01.description: A brief, isolated mechanical clank and resonance resembling a heavy metal latch, hatch, or cargo container snapping shut.
Amb_GroanDeepCave_01.arc: A single mechanical closure sound that decays quickly into natural silence.

sections.description: Short mechanical impact and metallic lock mechanism engaging, tailing off into silence.

use_for: airlock or bulkhead door latching shut
closing a heavy metal weapons crate or cargo locker

Amb_MoanSpookyCaveStereo_01.description: A hollow, resonant gust of airy wind combined with a deep sub-bass sweep, functioning as an eerie ambient transition or environmental whoosh.
Amb_MoanSpookyCaveStereo_01.arc: Swells into a resonant airy whoosh with a low-end rumble, peaking around mid-length before decaying into subtle low air.

sections.description: Deep breath-like wind whoosh swells and fades out over a low drone.

Amb_MoanSpookyCaveStereo_02.arc: A quick low-frequency riser leading into a massive distorted brass/braam impact that resonates and slowly dissipates.

sections.description: Rising sub-bass swell leading into a heavy, distorted braam impact at 00:03, decaying into a long reverberant tail.

use_for: sudden terrifying reveal of a massive enemy ship or leviathan

sections.description: Solo tuned metallic percussion enters immediately, establishing a cyclic, melodic ostinato.
Pattern concludes and individual resonant tones are allowed to decay naturally into silence.

use_for: exploring serene alien temples or natural shrines
stealth or puzzle-solving in peaceful ancient ruins
introspective character moments in ritualistic settings

holiday_emitter_long_02.description: A solo, delicate music box plays a melancholic and gentle lullaby-like melody.
holiday_emitter_long_02.arc: Static, repeating phrases on a music box with consistent timbre and tempo throughout.

sections.description: Solo music box introduces a simple, nostalgic, minor/modal melody with gentle chime decay.
The melody continues with subtle variation and repeats before letting the final notes ring out to silence.

holiday_emitter_long_02.opening: solo instrument plays cleanly from the start
use_for: abandoned nursery or ruined home exploration

holiday_emitter_long_03.description: A somber, steady cue driven by a minimalist piano motif over muted, slow military-style percussion and sustained low strings.
holiday_emitter_long_03.arc: Remains static and reflective throughout, cycling a sparse piano figure over a muted, measured pulse.

sections.description: Sparse piano notes enter over deep string beds and a soft, repeating low drum pulse, continuing until a gentle fade.

Horner_MM_Open_MX_HornerTheme_LoopStart_.description: A steady, suspenseful mid-tempo percussion groove driven by muted taikos, wooden clicks, and rustling shakers.
Horner_MM_Open_MX_HornerTheme_LoopStart_.arc: Static loop structure maintaining a continuous, focused rhythm and suspense level throughout.

sections.description: Establishment of the driving 120 BPM percussion groove with low toms, shaker patterns, and crisp rim clicks over a faint drone.
Final bar concludes cleanly at the loop point.

Horner_MM_Open_MX_Menace_A.description: A deep, ominous cinematic transition stinger with subterranean sub-bass rumbles, eerie metallic scraping, and vast cavernous reverberation.
Horner_MM_Open_MX_Menace_A.arc: Subterranean rumble with scraped metal textures enters, swells slightly in resonance, and slowly dissipates into cavernous silence.

sections.description: Low frequency impact and heavy rumble introduce a scraping, resonant metallic friction sound.
The metallic texture swells slightly before decaying into long, deep reverberation.

Horner_MM_Open_MX_Menace_A.opening: low sub-bass rumble and metallic scrape
use_for: entering an abandoned derelict space hulk

Horner_MM_Open_MX_MiraSurrenders_LoopSta.description: A dark, atmospheric drone bed featuring low rumbling sub-bass and eerie metallic groans. It builds a quiet sense of dread and suspense before fading into silence.
Horner_MM_Open_MX_MiraSurrenders_LoopSta.arc: Begins with low atmospheric rumble and metallic resonance, slowly swells into a dissonant cluster of low brass/synth textures, then decays to a low rumble.

sections.description: Subtle deep sub-bass drone with eerie, cavernous metallic friction sounds.
Sinister dissonant swell enters with low brass and synthetic textures, ratcheting up tension.
The peak subsides into a trailing, low-frequency atmospheric decay.

Horner_MM_Open_MX_MiraSurrenders_LoopSta.opening: fade in with low rumble and distant metallic scrapes
use_for: Exploring an abandoned alien derelict or infested corridor
Discovering a grisly crime scene or horrifying alien cocoon
Quiet moments of lurking danger before an ambush

Horner_MM_Open_MX_Wings in Space.description: A brief, atmospheric orchestral stinger featuring ominous low brass, an ethereal wordless choir swell, and a decaying ambient tail. Best suited for title cards, chapter markers, or mysterious discoveries.
Horner_MM_Open_MX_Wings in Space.arc: Strikes with a deep brass and choir chord that swells upward in pitch and intensity, before dissolving into a long, reverberant ambient tail.

sections.description: Deep brass hit and atmospheric choir swell upward into an unresolved, mystical chord.
Swell peaks and echoes out into a sustained, fading synth and choral reverb tail.

use_for: title cards or chapter title reveals
discovery of an ancient extraterrestrial monolith or artifact
cutscene transition following a shocking reveal
establishing shot of a deserted alien megastructure

Horner_MM_Open_MX_Z01_StringsOnly.description: A short, tragic orchestral cue led by sweeping, mournful high strings supported by heavy low brass and bass chords.
Horner_MM_Open_MX_Z01_StringsOnly.arc: Enters on sustained dark harmony, swells expressively as upper strings climb to an emotional peak, and settles onto a low chord.

sections.description: Lush, dark strings and low brass swell into an expressive, tragic melody that rises and then sustains into silence.

use_for: character death or solemn realization in a cutscene
discovery of ruins or a battlefield aftermath

hots_music_space_ambient.description: Dark, ritualistic cue driven by heavy war drums, guttural low male throat-singing drones, and menacing orchestral brass swells.
hots_music_space_ambient.arc: Establishes a sparse, threatening drum cadence before layering deep vocal throat chants and slowly swelling low brass, peaking with a sudden dramatic hit before decaying into an eerie ambient drone.

sections.description: Sparse, heavy low percussion and deep bass rumbles establish a slow, menacing cadence with metallic textures.
Guttural, resonant low male vocal drones enter over the steady rhythmic drum hits.
Ominous low brass and dark orchestral layers swell underneath the relentless war-drum pulse.
Rhythm and chanting continue to mount tension, layered with eerie shimmering metallic pads.
A sharp brass hit cuts the rhythm, leaving deep dissonant brass and sub-bass drones to decay into silence.

HOTS_Music_Zerus_Ambient.description: A sleek, mid-tempo electronic track driven by a pulsing synth bass, crisp percussion loops, and airy synthesizer textures. Ideal for low-key tactical planning, hacking sequences, or stealthy infiltration.
HOTS_Music_Zerus_Ambient.arc: Maintains a steady, hypnotic groove throughout, slowly introducing subtle melodic synth flourishes and filter sweeps before gently winding down.

sections.description: Intro establishes the rhythmic synth bass pulse and introduces crisp electronic percussion.
The main groove solidifies with full beat, steady bassline, and warm synth pads.
Atmospheric synth motifs and arpeggios enter, adding subtle melodic interest over the persistent beat.
Subtle dynamic variations and filter sweeps introduce new textural layers while keeping the pulse steady.
Rhythm and synths gradually wind down into a soft, ambient fade.

HOTS_Music_Zerus_Ambient.opening: synth pulse and electronic percussion intro
use_for: map screens or tactical preparation cutscenes

HOTS_Music_Zerus_Ambient2.description: Deep, brooding dark ambient soundscape featuring low sub-bass drones, resonant metallic rumbles, and eerie textural pads. Evokes a sense of claustrophobia, quiet dread, and desolate emptiness.
HOTS_Music_Zerus_Ambient2.arc: Static and textural throughout, maintaining an oppressive atmosphere with subtle dynamic swells and distant metallic impacts that recede toward the end.

sections.description: Opens with deep bass synth drones, resonant low thuds, and faint eerie metallic resonance.
Subtle deep percussive pulses and swelling dissonant textures intensify the uneasy atmosphere.
Tension sustains through low rumblings and dark ambient sound design before slowly decaying into silence.

use_for: creeping through an infested hive corridor
stealth sequence in hostile alien territory

Human1.description: An expansive, mournful orchestral cue driven by sustained strings, distant percussion, and a haunting, wordless female vocalise that builds to an emotional, noble swell.
Human1.arc: Begins in quiet atmospheric suspense with fragile strings and harp, introduces a sorrowful solo soprano vocalise, steadily builds with noble brass and full choir, and gently subsides to a peaceful, unresolved ambient glow.

sections.description: High string drones, subtle harp arpeggios, and low ambient rumblings create a quiet, fragile landscape.
Ethereal, wordless solo female voice enters over deep low strings and soft, measured percussion.
Low brass and sweeping violins swell beneath the vocalise, increasing emotional gravity.
Full orchestral swell with noble French horns, shimmering strings, and layered choir reaching peak emotional catharsis.
Orchestral forces gradually decrescendo into soft sustained string chords and subtle ambient resonance to the end.

use_for: viewing ancient alien ruins or abandoned starships
a solemn funeral or tribute to a fallen hero

Human2.description: A grand, high-stakes symphonic action cue driven by militaristic brass fanfares, aggressive string ostinatos, and thundering orchestral percussion.
Human2.arc: Launches straight into high-intensity combat rhythms, cycles through soaring brass themes and suspenseful rhythmic breakdowns, and climaxes in a massive orchestral finale.

sections.description: Explosive cold open with aggressive string ostinatos, heavy timpani, and punchy low brass hits.
French horns and trumpets introduce a bold, heroic military melody over driving percussion.
Sudden dynamic drop into rhythmic staccato strings and crisp military snare, building tension.
Orchestral swell returns with soaring brass and rapid violin runs conveying a desperate struggle.
Full ensemble thematic reprise led by blazing trumpets and thunderous low-end percussion.
Climactic final push with rapid string flourishes, crashing cymbals, and heroic brass calls.
Grand tutti cadence hits, settling into a sustained brass and string chord that decays naturally.

use_for: heroic sacrifice or final stand cutscenes

Human3.description: A deep, brooding dark ambient cue driven by distant rhythmic pulses, hollow synth drones, and unsettling textural swells. It maintains a constant undercurrent of dread and stealthy unease without bursting into full action.
Human3.arc: Static and atmospheric; slowly evolves through shifting textures and intermittent low-end swells, maintaining sustained tension across the full duration before gradually fading out.

sections.description: Low drone establishes with distant mechanical pulse and eerie atmospheric textures.
Tension thickens with heavier sub-bass pulses and low distorted brass-like swells.
Texture pulls back slightly to cavernous ambient pads and sparse metallic echoes.
Pulse re-emerges alongside subtle swelling brass drones, creeping toward a muted peak.
Elements decay into deep sub rumble and fade to silence.

use_for: creeping through an infested derelict spacecraft
unsettling cutscenes revealing a hidden extraterrestrial threat

HumanDefeat.description: A tender, bittersweet solo piano melody draped over soft, airy string pads. It evokes poignant quietness, personal loss, and deep emotional reflection.
HumanDefeat.arc: Atmospheric string pads introduce a delicate, reflective piano theme that softly breathes through a bittersweet phrase before gently resolving into silence.

sections.description: Warm, airy string pad fades in to establish a calm, desolate space.
Expressive solo piano introduces a poignant, hesitant melody with spacious phrasing.
Harmonies softly resolve as the final piano notes linger into long reverb tails and fade out.

use_for: surveying a devastated home or ruin
contemplative moment looking at a sentimental keepsake

HumanVictory.description: A brooding, atmospheric cue driven by deep sub-bass drones, subtle industrial scrapes, and a slow, ominous synth swell.
HumanVictory.arc: Starts in murky, low-register ambiance and slowly builds in intensity with rising synth pads and a subtle low pulse before tapering into silence.

sections.description: Deep resonant drone with sparse metallic scraping sound design.
Subtle low-end rhythmic rumble enters with dark, swelling synth horn textures.
Textures reach a low peak of suspense and linger with fading resonance.

use_for: creeping through an abandoned derelict ship

HumanX1.description: A solemn and sacred orchestral hymn that begins with monastic male choral chanting and swells into a rich, mournful string elegy.
HumanX1.arc: Starts with an a cappella male chant, expands gradually with low orchestral undertones and brass, peaks in an expansive and emotional string elegy, and gently resolves into silence.

sections.description: A cappella male voices chant a slow, sacred wordless melody in a cavernous space.
Low cellos and double basses enter beneath the voices, establishing a deep harmonic foundation.
Warm horns and full string sections swell into deliberate, stately chords alongside the continuing vocal lines.
High strings assume the lead, delivering a mournful, soaring melodic phrase over rich orchestral and choral harmony.
The choir recedes as the string ensemble performs a somber, hymn-like elegiac passage.
The instrumentation thins down to a quiet low bass pedal note and gentle string reverb tail, fading to silence.

use_for: memorial or funeral for a fallen hero

IllidansTheme.description: A slow-building, dread-soaked cue driven by heavy low percussion and menacing orchestral brass swells.
IllidansTheme.arc: Starts with sparse, deep percussive impacts and dark drones, steadily introduces rhythmic war drums, and culminates in heavy brass swells before decaying to low ambient rumble.

sections.description: Sparse, resonant low percussion hits over a subterranean drone and subtle metallic atmosphere.
A deliberate, steady tribal drum rhythm enters, gradually establishing a slow suspenseful pulse.
Ominous low brass swells enter in dialogue with the percussion, heightening tension.
The brass motif reaches its peak weight and drama over insistent war drums.
Percussion and brass drop away, leaving a final resonant strike and deep ambient decay.

use_for: enemy fleet approaching slowly on radar
entering a hostile, dormant alien hive
stealth infiltration into heavily defended enemy territory

Jukebox_AmericanTrilogy.description: An emotionally sweeping Americana ballad medley led by a resonant male solo vocalist, building from an intimate acoustic arrangement into an epic orchestral and choral anthem.
Jukebox_AmericanTrilogy.arc: Starts tender and nostalgic with solo flute, guitar, and baritone vocal, steadily layers in piano and strings, swells into a grand gospel-choir hymn, pauses for an intimate lullaby passage, and finishes with a monumental orchestral climax.

sections.description: Fife-like flute leads a nostalgic melody over acoustic guitar and warm string pads.
Solo male vocal enters with an intimate, solemn delivery over soft accompaniment.
Full choir, piano, and marching drum kit join to create a swelling, majestic choral hymn.
Dynamic drop to a tender, bittersweet vocal interlude over muted guitar and strings.
Explosive build into a full-scale orchestral and gospel-choir crescendo with roaring brass and timpani.
Final dramatic chord strikes and slowly decays into silence.

Jukebox_AmericanTrilogy.opening: solo flute melody over gentle acoustic guitar strumming
use_for: reflective cinematic after a grueling campaign

Jukebox_DimLights.description: Mid-tempo vintage honky-tonk country song featuring a twangy male lead vocal, pedal steel guitar, and a shuffling barroom rhythm about nightlife temptations.
Jukebox_DimLights.arc: Classic verse-chorus song structure punctuated by pedal steel solos, ending with a traditional slowed vocal and cadence.

sections.description: Short instrumental pickup featuring pedal steel guitar and steady rhythm section.
First chorus delivery of the core hook over classic country bounce.
Verse 1 lamenting home life and neglected family.
Chorus repeats with twangy steel guitar fills.
Instrumental solo section led by pedal steel guitar.
Verse 2 addressing drinking and dancing in honky-tonks.
Second instrumental bridge spotlighting steel guitar melodies.
Final chorus repeating the hook and concluding with a classic country ritardando.

use_for: frontier spaceport dive bar or cantina diegetic music
jukebox background audio in an outpost saloon
melancholy character downtime moments between missions

Jukebox_Freebird.description: An iconic southern rock ballad opening with heartfelt vocals, piano, and slide guitar before transitioning into a high-octane, legendary guitar solo workout.
Jukebox_Freebird.arc: Gentle, emotional ballad section with soulful lead vocals builds gradually until 03:37, where a rapid tempo increase launches into an unrelenting, virtuosic dual-guitar rock jam.

sections.description: Intro featuring warm organ swells, lyrical piano, and soaring slide guitar melodies.
First vocal verse enters over steady drum beat, piano accompaniment, and weeping guitar lines.
First chorus declaring freedom, underpinned by soaring vocal refrains and slide fills.
Second verse and chorus; emotive vocal delivery grows more passionate and strained.
Dramatic tempo change and drum transition into a fast-driving 4/4 rock groove with fast guitar riffs.
Explosive triple/dual lead guitar solo over driving bass and drums, trading blistering licks until fade out.

Jukebox_Freebird.opening: Warm organ chord and piano phrase followed by slide guitar.
use_for: high-speed vehicular escape or aerial chase across an open wasteland
triumphant or bittersweet parting scene between rugged frontier characters

Jukebox_JemsSong.description: A gritty, mid-tempo trip-hop and funk groove driven by a dirty electric bassline, tight breakbeat drums, and smoky Rhodes piano chords.
Jukebox_JemsSong.arc: Establishes a steady, head-nodding groove with a bass riff and drum break, introducing electric piano layers and alternating between full beat loops and brief stripped-back rhythm passages.

sections.description: Solo fuzzy bass riff intro, quickly joined by an energetic, punchy drum break and rhythmic percussion.
Lush electric piano chords and synth textures join over the steady breakbeat groove.
Brief breakdown with filtered drums and sparse instrumentation, rebuilding into the full beat.
Return to the full funk groove with melodic synth fills and bass variations.
Atmospheric breakdown featuring isolated percussion and bass hits, slowly layering Rhodes chords back in.
Final reprise of the main groove reaching full instrumentation before coming to a stop.

Jukebox_RawPower.description: A fast, aggressive proto-punk rock anthem featuring blistering distorted guitars, driving drums, and raw, rebellious lead vocals.
Jukebox_RawPower.vocals: sung lyrics with screams and spoken ad-libs
Jukebox_RawPower.arc: High-octane and relentless from the start, cycling through energetic verses and choruses into an unhinged, frantic guitar solo and vocal outro that fades out.

sections.description: Vocal grunt followed by an explosive blast of high-tempo distorted electric guitar riffs and pounding drum beat.
First verse and chorus with urgent, sneering male lead vocals over driving garage rock instrumentation.
Rhythmic bridge section with call-and-response vocals over a steady groove.
Second verse and chorus escalating in vocal grit and intensity.
Bridge returns with repeated vocal refrains protesting control.
Third verse and building chant ('Can you feel it?'), increasing in manic intensity.
Chaotic, shredding guitar solo and vocal screams riding out the track until a fade out.

Jukebox_RawPower.opening: cold hit with vocal grunt followed by an immediate full-band burst

Jukebox_Rumble.description: A slow, melancholic blues-rock cue driven by expressive electric guitar leads, heavy bass, and sparse, laid-back drumming. Evokes a dusty, reflective frontier atmosphere.
Jukebox_Rumble.arc: Introduces a slow, brooding riff before settling into an emotive, slow-burning electric guitar solo that swells slightly in intensity before ringing out to a natural finish.

sections.description: Sparse intro featuring low bass notes and chorused electric guitar arpeggios.
Drums enter with a slow, heavy groove while an expressive lead guitar plays a sorrowful blues solo.
Subtle build in emotional intensity with higher guitar bends, sustained notes, and heavier crash cymbals.
Final chord progression swelling and decaying naturally into amp resonance and silence.

Jukebox_Rumble.opening: solo electric guitar and bass riff
use_for: mourning fallen comrades after a battle
lonely travel across a desolate wasteland

Jukebox_Scribblin.description: An upbeat vintage rockabilly song featuring twangy slapback electric guitar, a driving rhythm section, and boastful male vocals about being uneducated but street-smart.
Jukebox_Scribblin.arc: High-energy rock 'n' roll song structure alternating between fast-talking verses, hooky refrains, and fiery guitar solos before a classic showstopper hit ending.

sections.description: Intro guitar lick establishing the fast rockabilly groove.
Verse 1 and refrain with energetic lead vocals.
Verse 2 continuing the playful narrative into the chorus.
Extended twangy electric guitar solo with drum breaks.
Verse 3 and chorus returning with vocal swagger.
Verse 4 pushing into the final vocal refrain.
Second blazing guitar solo leading to a climactic full-band finish.

Jukebox_Scribblin.opening: solo instrument pickup riff followed by a full band drop
use_for: diegetic radio or jukebox music in a frontier colony dive bar
rowdy vehicle joyrides or smuggling montages
informal hangout scenes with rogue human crew members

Jukebox_SuspiciousMinds.description: Soulful rock ballad featuring a deep, impassioned male baritone backed by female singers, driving guitars, horns, and drums. Lyrically focused on jealousy and failing romantic trust.
Jukebox_SuspiciousMinds.arc: Classic verse-chorus progression with an emotional, downtempo bridge section before ramping back into full-throttle choruses and an extended vamp fade-out.

sections.description: Guitar riff intro with tambourine and steady drum groove.
Verse 1 delivered by a deep baritone vocal over guitar and rhythm section.
First chorus with female vocal harmonies and swelling brass/strings.
Verse 2 maintaining the driving rhythm and earnest vocal delivery.
Second chorus with intense dynamic energy.
Slower, heartfelt bridge section with pleading vocals and softer rhythm support.
Energy kicks back in for an extended chorus and call-and-response vocal vamp.
Repetitive vocal ad-libs over continuing groove, fading out gradually.

use_for: narrative montage depicting emotional fallout between characters
driving an old rover across wasteland terrain

Jukebox_SweetHomeAlabama.description: Classic Southern rock track driven by an iconic arpeggiated guitar riff, upbeat groove, energetic piano accents, and full lead and harmony vocals.
Jukebox_SweetHomeAlabama.vocals: sung lyrics with female backing vocal harmonies
Jukebox_SweetHomeAlabama.arc: Traditional verse-chorus song structure featuring a dual-lead guitar solo at mid-track and an extended bluesy guitar and piano jam outro that fades out.

sections.description: Count-in intro featuring the iconic clean guitar riff, joined by drums, bass, and rhythm guitar fills.
First two verses with lead male vocal over the signature guitar groove and light piano fills.
Anthemic chorus featuring stacked backing vocal harmonies and triumphant chords.
Third verse and second chorus with energetic piano counter-melodies and guitar embellishments.
Extended guitar solo trade-offs over driving bass and energetic boogie-woogie piano chords.
Final verse transitioning into an extended double chorus.
Outro jam driven by an expressive, bluesy guitar solo and rolling piano chords, slowly fading out.

Jukebox_SweetHomeAlabama.opening: Spoken count-in followed by a solo electric guitar riff before the full band kicks in.
use_for: Frontier human spaceport bars, cantinas, or garages
Joyriding across rugged terrestrial colony terrain in rovers or gunships
Lighthearted banter among rustic space truckers, miners, or mercenary crews
avoid_for: Alien horror attacks or tense stealth missions
Sacred or ancient ethereal alien environments

Jukebox_TerranUpTheNight.description: An explosive, high-octane southern hard rock song driven by heavy distorted guitar riffs, aggressive drums, and raspy swaggering male vocals about military vehicle combat.
Jukebox_TerranUpTheNight.vocals: raspy male lead vocals with shouting backing vocals
Jukebox_TerranUpTheNight.arc: Full verse-chorus song featuring heavy opening riffs, soaring choruses, an extended shredding guitar solo, and an aggressive climactic outro that resolves with ringing guitar chords and engine sound effects.

sections.description: Industrial engine revving, radio callouts, and heavy guitar riffs ramping up into the full band groove.
Verse 1: Gravelly lead vocals enter over a chugging rhythm section describing mechanized warfare.
Chorus: Uplifting, rowdy vocal hook with layered backing vocals and driving drums.
Verse 2: Mid-tempo verse groove maintaining aggressive energy and swagger.
Chorus 2: Return of the anthemic hook.
Blistering electric guitar solo accompanied by energetic rhythm section and vocal yells.
Bridge / Verse 3: Dynamics pull back slightly before building intensity with vocal call-and-response.
Verse 4: Hard-hitting groove pushes toward the climactic finale.
Outro Chorus: Full-power repeated chorus phrases, wailing vocal shouts, and crashing cymbals.
Guitar ring-out, final drum cadence, and mechanical engine sound effects.

Jukebox_TerranUpTheNight.opening: cold hit of vehicle engine start and mechanical revs into spoken voice countdown and heavy riff
use_for: rowdy cantina or military bar background music
tongue-in-cheek victory celebration or end credits

Jukebox_ZergShotgunYou.description: A tongue-in-cheek southern country-rock song featuring a gravelly, deep male drawl singing comedic lyrics about shotguns, alien pests, and down-home junk. Ideal for frontier jukeboxes and comic relief scenes.
Jukebox_ZergShotgunYou.vocals: sung lyrics with comedic spoken-word monologue and callouts
Jukebox_ZergShotgunYou.arc: Strophic country-rock structure punctuated by lead guitar fills and solos, accelerating through an exhaustive inventory verse before settling into a spoken outro.

sections.description: Acoustic rhythm guitar intro locked into a laid-back mid-tempo country-rock drum and bass beat.
First lyrical stanza listing 'Shotgun, Zerg, You' with bluesy electric guitar answers.
Second stanza adding 'Pickup, Protoss, You' over the repeating groove.
Third stanza listing 'Shovel, Bucket, You'.
Twangy electric lead guitar solo over the verse progression.
Fourth stanza detailing 'Boots, Socks, You'.
Second electric guitar solo with country-fried bends and licks.
Extended rapid catalog verse accumulating all items including whiskey, Coke, candy, and gravestones.
Brief blues-rock guitar solo transition into the spoken section.
Spoken-word frontier monologue advising how to deal with aliens over the rhythm groove.
Outro dialogue winding down into a loose final guitar ring-out.

Jukebox_ZergShotgunYou.opening: acoustic guitar strum establishing the tempo before rhythm section kicks in
use_for: cantina or bar jukebox background music

LibertyMusicCreepStinger_A.arc: Strikes immediately with a heavy hit and descending brass swell, then dissipates into a thin, eerie sustained drone that gently fades out.

LibertyMusicCreepStinger_A.opening: Heavy impact with pitch-bending brass swell

LibertyMusicLightStinger_A.description: A brief, gentle solo acoustic guitar phrase played with fingerpicking warmth and a touch of melancholy. Rings out to a peaceful resolve.

sections.description: Solo fingerpicked acoustic guitar introduces a bittersweet melodic line.

LibertyMusicLightStinger_B.description: A short, gritty southern rock riff driven by a distorted electric guitar groove, punchy bass, and a steady drum beat, concluding on a sustained ring-out.
LibertyMusicLightStinger_B.arc: Establishes a dirty blues-rock groove immediately, repeats the riff pattern, and hits a final resolved chord that sustains and decays.

LibertyMusicLightStinger_C.opening: clean acoustic guitar fingerpicking starts immediately

LibertyMusicLightStinger_D.description: A brief, wistful acoustic guitar fingerpicking motif accompanied by high metallic harmonics and subtle room ambiance. Ideal for a reflective quiet discovery or setting down at a frontier campsite.

sections.description: Fades in on a low, rumbling drone accompanied by quiet metallic overtone hums and cavernous space.
Deep sub-bass resonance gently surges while faint, bowed metallic friction sounds hover in the high-mid register.
The low rumble thickens with subtle granular texture and low-frequency pulses.
The droning slowly recedes into silence, leaving faint residual low hums.

use_for: exploring dark subterranean tunnels or a derelict spacecraft
stealth sections where unseen danger lurks nearby
tense cutscenes featuring dormant alien machinery or hive environments

SC1_Protoss3.description: Melancholic acoustic guitar and dulcimer textures drift over dark atmospheric drones, sparse percussion, and mournful orchestral swells. It evokes quiet desolation and weary frontier survival.
SC1_Protoss3.arc: Begins with sparse ambient drones and lonely plucked guitar figures, gently expanding with low percussion and warm string pads before settling back into a quiet, introspective fade.

sections.description: Subtle wind atmospheric drone introducing quiet, isolated plucked string motifs.
Acoustic fingerpicking takes melodic focus alongside deep bass pulses and ambient resonance.
Low cinematic percussion enters with sustained cello and string pads, building an emotional, melancholic swell.
Slow rhythmic pulse stabilizes with evocative guitar arpeggios and low string chords.
Instruments thin out, leaving lone guitar notes ringing over fading low ambient drones.

use_for: quiet aftermath of an ambushed convoy

SC1_Protoss4.description: A deep, foreboding dark ambient drone textured with echoing metallic impacts, low sub-bass vibrations, and eerie synth resonance. It sustains a prolonged atmosphere of quiet menace and isolation.
SC1_Protoss4.arc: Static and slowly shifting; maintains a constant low-register drone punctuated by distant, echoing metallic clangs and low rumble swells throughout.

sections.description: Low rumbling synthetic drone sets in with subtle atmospheric movement and distant echoing bass hits.
Drone deepens slightly, introducing resonant metallic tones and eerie sustained synth harmonics.
Sub-bass vibrations become more prominent amidst lingering, cavernous metallic scrapes.
Slow low-end swells and deep distant impacts resound against the dark ambient floor.
Fades gradually into dark silence.

SC1_Protoss4.opening: fade in on low drone and sub-bass resonance
use_for: exploring an infested or abandoned derelict spacecraft

SC1_Terran1.description: Gritty acoustic guitar picking and heavy tom beats transition into a driving military rock cue featuring distorted electric guitar riffs and solemn male choral chants.
SC1_Terran1.arc: Begins with sparse, tense acoustic picking over tribal tom hits, builds with distorted electric guitar and rock drums, and peaks midway with monastic vocal chants before a sustained, heavy resolution.

sections.description: Subdued acoustic guitar arpeggios layered with deep, resonant tom percussion and low string drones.
Full rock drum kit and crunching electric guitar riffs enter, establishing a mid-tempo tactical march.
Chanting male choir joins the rhythm section, elevating the cue to epic, sacred combat intensity.
Vocal chants recede as the electric guitar and rhythm section sustain an energetic, steady military groove.
Rhythm section drops out leaving decaying guitar feedback, resonant percussion tails, and synth drone.

use_for: tactical planning before a high-stakes ground assault
armored vehicle convoy moving through rugged frontier terrain
heroic last stand against mounting enemy waves

SC1_Terran2.description: High-octane electronic action cue with driving breakbeats, aggressive synth bass, and futuristic pulse. Built for continuous combat, high-speed chases, or tense infiltration sequences.
SC1_Terran2.arc: Maintains an urgent, steady pulse throughout, moving between intense beat-driven passages and briefer synth-focused breakdowns that build back to the groove.

sections.description: Opens immediately with a driving electronic drum beat, pulsing bassline, and high-energy synth loops.
Brief breakdown with filtered percussion and sustained synth beds before the rhythm ramps back up.
Full beat resumes with additional high-register synth melodies and driving low-end motion.
Secondary dynamic dip introducing subtle rhythmic variations and evolving textural synths.
Final high-intensity driving section with peak rhythmic layering and aggressive synth lines.
Outro groove winds down towards a decay ending.

SC1_Terran2.opening: cold hit with immediate driving beat and bassline

SC1_Terran3.description: A dark, menacing orchestral hybrid cue driven by heavy brass swells, industrial percussion, and ominous choir. Builds steadily from brooding dread into a relentless, epic march.
SC1_Terran3.arc: Begins with low brooding drones and threatening brass, gradually layers in steady marching percussion, swells with a powerful choir and apocalyptic brass themes, and reaches a huge crescendo before decaying to reverb.

sections.description: Brooding low brass swells, sub-bass drones, and distant metallic clangs establishing deep foreboding.
Steady mid-tempo industrial/orchestral percussion enters with creeping string ostinatos and low horn pulses.
Wordless choir and grand, fatalistic brass melodies join the rhythm, ratcheting up scale and epic tension.
Full orchestral climax with pounding drums, screaming high brass, and dramatic choral chords.
Final heavy brass-percussion impacts, decaying into low resonance and fading out.

SC1_Terran3.opening: low atmospheric drone and deep brass swell
use_for: reveal of a massive enemy fleet or weapon of mass destruction
inexorable enemy march advancing on a defensive stronghold
grim cutscene showing the fall of a city or world

SC1_Terran4.description: A slow-building dark ambient and orchestral suspense cue that progresses from subtle metallic clicks and ominous synth drones into a massive, dread-soaked brass and string crescendo.
SC1_Terran4.arc: Begins as a quiet, atmospheric bed of metallic ticks and cold bass drones, gradually introducing brass swells and tremolo strings that escalate into a massive, apocalyptic orchestral peak before decaying into reverb.

sections.description: Sparse, cold atmosphere with low sub-bass drones, metallic resonance, and subtle clicking percussion.
Low brass tones and synthesized pulses enter, gradually heightening suspense and foreboding.
Full orchestral strings enter with slow, rising dissonant harmonies alongside menacing horn calls.
Massive, catastrophic climax with full heavy brass, sweeping strings, and heavy percussive impacts.
Final sustained, dark orchestral chord rings out and slowly decays into silence.

use_for: exploring an infested or abandoned derelict spacecraft
a terrifying narrative revelation of impending destruction
discovering a massive alien hive or weapon awakening
catastrophic cutscenes leading into an unwinnable scenario

SC1_Zerg1.description: A cavernous, deeply ominous sci-fi horror soundscape that moves from industrial-metallic ambiance into haunting, low overtone vocal drones. It builds an intense atmosphere of subterranean dread and ancient menace.
SC1_Zerg1.arc: Begins in near silence with sparse metallic clicks and low rumbles, steadily thickens into heavy dissonant pads, and climaxes in the final minute with a deep, eerie throat-singing drone.

sections.description: Sparse, subterranean atmosphere with dripping reverberations, metallic scrapes, and low sub-bass frequencies.
Dread mounts as dissonant synth pads and sustained low brass-like textures swell beneath erratic metallic impacts.
Tension concentrates into deep, hollow rumbles and distant reverberant spatial textures.
A haunting, deep overtone throat-singing drone enters, accompanied by low brass swells before slowly decaying into silence.

SC1_Zerg1.opening: fade in with subterranean sub-bass and sparse metallic resonance
use_for: exploring an abandoned underground hive or alien infested derelict

SC1_Zerg2.description: Begins as an eerie, cavernous dark ambient drone with screeching metallic textures before erupting into a propulsive, industrial sci-fi combat groove driven by aggressive percussion.
SC1_Zerg2.arc: A long, tense ambient build-up over three and a half minutes transforms abruptly into a high-energy, driving industrial drum groove that sustains intense momentum until a sudden decay.

Distorted, singing synth tones emerge over deep low-end drones, sounding mournful and alien.
Tension ramps up with high, piercing harmonic squeals and dissonant mechanical textures.
A rapid, driving industrial percussion groove drops in with heavy kicks and tribal synth pulses.
Peak combat energy with frantic top-end rhythmic percussion, ending on a fast decay.

SC1_Zerg3.description: Expansive, atmospheric ambient cue opening with shimmering crystalline textures and sparse acoustic guitar plucks before blooming into ethereal synth pads and wordless vocals.

The guitar pattern fragments amidst expanding airy synth pads and eerie bell tones.
A low rumble brings in soft choral synth pads, increasing the emotional weight and mystery.
Sustained wordless vocal melody joins undulating warm synth sweeps and gentle low-end movement.

SC1_Zerg4.description: A brooding sci-fi dark ambient bed driven by deep subterranean sub-bass drones, metallic clicks, and ominous synthesizer swells. Creates an unrelenting atmosphere of cold dread and lurking danger.
SC1_Zerg4.arc: Maintains a persistent level of dark suspense, introducing subtle mechanical clicks and evolving harmonic drone layers before slowly dissolving into cavernous silence.

use_for: navigating a derelict spaceship or dead research facility

Space_1_FULL.description: A dark, brooding orchestral suspense cue driven by a steady low-string ostinato, cinematic percussion hits, and haunting wordless female vocals. It steadily escalates dread before trailing off into an ominous atmospheric rumble.
Space_1_FULL.arc: Starts sparse with deep percussive impacts and a repeating low-string pulse, gradually layers in haunting vocal laments and brass swells to a mid-level peak, then winds down to a quiet decaying sub-bass drone.

Chugging low-string ostinato and subtle tick percussion enter to establish a deliberate, suspenseful pulse.
Haunting, mournful solo female vocal melody enters over the continuing ostinato, joined by distant brass textures.
Peak of tension with fuller brass swells, sharper string accents, and heavier percussive hits.
Rhythm drops away, leaving a sustained low sub-bass drone and atmospheric reverb tail that fade out.

Space_1_FULL.opening: low percussion hit with atmospheric sub-bass drone

Space_2_FULL.description: A slow, mournful string ensemble cue with deep synth pad undertones, evoking heavy grief, tragedy, and somber reflection.
Space_2_FULL.arc: Remains deeply quiet and introspective throughout, gently swelling in dynamic and harmonic density around the midway point before softening back into low sustained chords.

The string arrangement reaches a solemn emotional peak before tapering down to a sustained low chord and decaying into silence.

Space_Battle_2_FULL.description: Relentless, pulse-driven cinematic action cue driven by massive tribal/industrial percussion, ominous bass pulses, and dark brass stabs.

Space_Battle_2_FULL.opening: cold hit with low synth bass pulse and heavy drum strike
